title: Review of c40's wide local-cut finding on fresh seed 8: with fuel regrowth cut in a disk of 0.75x the nearest-neighbour distance, the target dissolves (246 -> 0 px by +450 t) while its fed twin keeps 239-251 px and the bodies outside go 12 -> 15 by their own divisions in both arms; Supported
summary: I ran the finding's world.py with labkit on seed 8 (t=12000: 13 bodies, 9 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges) and the finding's cut.py with FRAC 0.75 on seed 8 (controls/: cut at t=12000 on the most isolated body, nearest neighbour 49 px, disk radius 36.9 px, 1500 t after). Cut arm: fuel in the disk 0.82 -> 0.54-0.67; target area 246 -> 156 (+50 t) -> 46 (+150 t) -> 14 (+400 t) -> 0 px at +450 t and stays 0 to +1450 t (controls/cutw_s8.png). Fed twin: 239-251 px throughout. Bodies outside the disk: 12 -> 13 (t~12950) -> 15 (t~13450) in both arms at the same times, so the neighbours are untouched by the cut. This matches the finding's seed 1 (221 -> 0 by +600 t) and is stronger than its seed 0 (32-52 px remnant): a per-individual supply cut kills one condensate while its neighbours live and divide.

observations.E: controls/cutw_s8.json: target 246 -> 0 px by t=12450 under the local cut vs 239-251 px in the fed twin; bodies outside 12 -> 15 identically in both arms (controls/cutw_s8.png)

seeds_run.result: pass: target dead by +450 t, fed twin intact, outside bodies unchanged between arms

controls_run.E: controls/cutw_s8.json, controls/cutw_s8.png (fed twin vs 0.75x local cut from the same state at t=12000, seed 8); labkit re-run rerun/seed8

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The 0.75x disk reaches to within ~12 px of the nearest neighbour's centre, so the cut is local but not strictly confined to the target's own supply zone; fuel inside the disk stays at 0.54-0.67 (diffusion from outside), so the body dies of reduced, not zero, supply.
